verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Visa publishing the Trusted Agent Protocol as an open spec, aligned with web-bot-auth, with its own reference implementation (agent-registry, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend, tap-agent). It does not document any independent third party implementing the protocol or platform. The only hint of an outside party is a community comment about a ChatGPT integration, which is a single vendor partnership rather than two independent implementations. Openness and a sample ecosystem are building blocks, not proof of an ecosystem.
